comparison.objective: Extract a wireless mouse receiver from storage and insert it into a laptop; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part extraction, regrasping, alignment, and connector insertion versus hex-key engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, torque-limited locking, and repeated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Receiver transferred and plugged in versus two bounded carriage stops without bottoming or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both require precision alignment, but connector transfer and adjustable-damper commissioning test different mechanisms and outcomes. No spec versions or insertion-depth/force thresholds were supplied.
